name: New Era
verdict: Controlled by its founding Koch family of Buffalo (fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch); ACON Investments holds a significant stake. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of the LIV Golf League (multi-year partnership announced by LIV Golf and New Era Cap, April 2024); New Era logo appears in the OKGC team page partner grid as on every LIV team page. Ownership per Reuters (2024-06-06): controlled by the founding Koch family, ACON Investments significant; MLB/NFL/NBA minority stakes were reported in the 2022 ACON continuation-fund coverage. No state owner; nothing passes the METHOD.md test.
